title: CredentialsFile
description: Credentials file (credentials.json) for the FAU flowgraph deployer: serial-console logins keyed by the same board names as bitstreams.json. Follows ~/repos/Unified-FAU-Modem-Test-Tooling's credentials.json (minus its psu and ntfy sections, which this tool has no use for) in being a separate, GITIGNORED file -- copy json/example_credentials.json and edit it. Entirely optional: absent, the deployer falls back to the documented petalinux/1234, and either front-end can override per session. A board may be omitted; only the ones listed here override the default.

propertyNames.description: Board name, matching a key in bitstreams.json.
